description:
Pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice putting Chandra, Pyromaster onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, Torch of Defiance to your hand.
+1 Chandra, Pyromaster targeting an opponent.
Then pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice once again, putting Chandra, Torch of Defiance onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, Pyromaster to your hand.
+1 Chandra adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.
